run_f_gold: run f_gold to rearrange a sorted array into maximum minimum alternating form
test_f_gold: test f_gold with multiple parameter sets and compare results against f_filled
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use in-place swaps instead of a temporary array
review_f_gold: review f_gold two-pointer approach for alternating max min array rearrangement
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which alternates largest and smallest elements from a sorted array
